OpenAI 与 Oracle 正在将 Oracle 的应用和数据引入 ChatGPT，并用 OpenAI 的模型和产品为新的 Oracle 产品和服务提供支持。双方共同的目标是帮助企业利用 AI 运行核心业务、构建更好的应用并加强安全性。

inlines.text: OpenAI 与 Oracle 正在将 Oracle 的应用和数据引入 ChatGPT，并用 OpenAI 的模型和产品为新的 Oracle 产品和服务提供支持。双方共同的目标是帮助企业利用 AI 运行核心业务、构建更好的应用并加强安全性。

blocks.text: 这建立在双方在 OpenAI API、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 上的商业合作关系之上。Oracle报告称⁠，ChatGPT 活跃用户达 130,000 名，Codex 活跃用户超过 95,000 名。其招聘团队使用 ChatGPT Work 进行市场调研，过去整理这类调研需要两到四天，现在准备工作只需 15–20 分钟。

blocks.text: OpenAI 与 Oracle 对面向智能体的企业有着共同的愿景：人与 AI 智能体在一个互联的环境中跨业务应用协同工作。我们的目标是让 Oracle 软件更易于发现、使用和管理，提供更简单的管理方式、统一登录，以及由各组织的权限和审批机制管控的访问。这将帮助企业将 AI 扩展到核心业务，并从他们已在使用的软件中获得更多价值。

inlines.text: ，通过与 Oracle 应用和数据的集成，将这一愿景带入 ChatGPT。目标是让人们描述自己需要完成的任务、找到正确的信息，并在一处完成已获批准的业务工作流。

blocks.text: 例如，一位新加入财务团队的成员可以使用 ChatGPT 调查成本、了解采购决策，并确定月末结账前还有哪些工作待完成。预期的体验将把来自财务、采购和规划应用的信息汇集在一起，帮助更多员工在所属组织的权限和审批范围内使用 Oracle 软件。

blocks.text: OpenAI and Oracle share a vision for an agent-ready enterprise where people and AI agents work across business applications in one connected environment. Our goal is to make Oracle software easier to discover, use, and manage, with simpler administration, unified sign-in, and access governed by each organization’s permissions and approvals. This would help businesses scale AI across core operations and get more value from the software they already use.

This would help businesses scale AI across core operations and get more value from the software they already use.

blocks.text: Working with Oracle in ChatGPT

Oracle is developing Oracle AI Workspace⁠ to bring that vision into ChatGPT through integrations with Oracle applications and data. The goal is to let people describe what they need to accomplish, find the right information, and complete approved business workflows in one place.

inlines.text: to bring that vision into ChatGPT through integrations with Oracle applications and data. The goal is to let people describe what they need to accomplish, find the right information, and complete approved business workflows in one place.

blocks.text: For example, a new finance team member could use ChatGPT to investigate costs, understand purchasing decisions, and identify what remains before month-end close. The intended experience would bring information from finance, procurement, and planning applications together, helping more employees use Oracle software within their organization’s permissions and approvals.
